description: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with multi-kernel support.
pre_install: # Upstream standalone bundle ships broken (missing cordis-plugin-group peer dep, symlink extraction needs admin). Install via npm instead, which resolves dependencies correctly.
# Refresh PATH from machine+user so npm from a freshly installed Node/nvm is visible even in an old terminal session.
# Prefer nvm's shim dir (Node >=24.9) over any stale Node earlier in PATH, since dsh engine requires >=24.9.

if (-not (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'npm not found. Install Node.js >=24.9 via nvm (nvm install 26; nvm use 26) or scoop install nodejs, then reopen your terminal and retry.' }
# nvm's npm.exe shim injects npm_mirror (a download URL, not a registry) as registry -> force official registry via CLI (highest precedence).
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'npm install failed; ensure Node.js >=24.9 is active on PATH.' }
notes: Requires Node.js >=24.9 on PATH (dsh engine requirement) and pnpm (first-run profile bootstrap). Node via nvm or 'scoop install nodejs'; pnpm is installed automatically as a dependency.
If nvm created a dead 'pnpm.exe' shim (Node 25+ removed corepack) ahead of Scoop's shims on PATH, rename it to 'pnpm.exe.disabled' in the nvm shim dir, or 'dsh-tui' first-run bootstrap will fail.
Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY before first launch (from https://platform.deepseek.com).
Config lives in ~/.dsh-tui/ and ~/.dsh/; installing via npm resolves all peer dependencies correctly.
